references.text: Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Simeon in the census.
Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, is the chief of the tribe of Simeon in the camp arrangement.
The conclusion of Shelumiel's offering on the fifth day.
Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, led the army of the tribe of Simeon during the wilderness journey.
Simeon was Jacob's second son with Leah, the ancestor of the tribe of Simeon.
The sons of Simeon are mentioned among those who went to Egypt, the origin of the tribe of Simeon.
